svg.text: Orchestrator-worker, with sequential handoffs where steps depend on each other and parallel fan-out where they don't. Models propose; code decides.
1 · INGESTION — parallel fan-out by source type
fan-out: one extractor per source type, one record per file, run in parallel
2 · CONTENT RUN — orchestrator-worker · sequential handoffs · parallel verification
ORCHESTRATOR (code) — dispatches every step below · per-run budget · revision cap = 2 · retry once · resume from last step · calls gate code for every decision
join: wait for all, then combine
shape structure & tone only — facts come from the registry
• agent crash / stall → retry once → fail loud with context, resume later
• budget reached → clean stop, partial run saved
• failed revision of approved copy → last approved version stays live
solid arrow = handoff · dashed = context / loop
